 By Sahil Behl Last Updated: Nov 17, 2026, 05:54 IST School Holiday Today, November 17, 2026: Schools in Bihar and Jharkhand will remain closed due to extended festive holidays. Check the complete state-wise list for Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Gujarat, Goa, Maharashtra and other states.
 School Holiday Today (November 17, 2026): Will Schools Remain Closed? Check State-Wise List Register for Result Updates School students across India are preparing to return to classrooms after the Diwali and Chhath Puja holidays. However, schools in some states will remain closed on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, due to extended festive vacations. 
 Bihar and Jharkhand are among the states where students will get an additional day off. Meanwhile, schools in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal are expected to reopen after the Chhath Puja break. The holiday schedule may differ across states, districts and individual schools. Here is a state-wise list of school holidays for November 17, 2026.

 Major State-Wise School Holiday Updates for November 17 
 1. Bihar: Schools to Reopen on November 18 
 Schools across Bihar will remain closed on November 17 as part of the extended festive vacation. According to the state’s 2026 academic holiday calendar, the break runs from November 7 to November 17. Students are expected to return to school on November 18. 
 2. Jharkhand: Schools to Remain Closed 
 Schools in Jharkhand will observe a holiday on November 17 on account of Chhath Puja. The state holiday schedule includes November 15, 16 and 17 as festival holidays. Students should confirm their reopening dates with their respective schools. 
 3. Delhi: Schools to Reopen After Chhath Puja 
 Schools in Delhi are expected to reopen on November 17. The Directorate of Education had declared November 16 a holiday for government, government-aided and recognised private schools on account of Chhath Puja. No additional statewide school holiday has been confirmed for November 17.  
 4. Uttar Pradesh: No Statewide Holiday 
 Schools across Uttar Pradesh are expected to resume regular classes on November 17. The state had observed Chhath-related holidays on November 15 and 16 in some areas. However, no statewide school closure has been confirmed for November 17. Local district orders may apply.  
 5. West Bengal: Schools to Reopen 
 Schools in West Bengal are expected to reopen on November 17 after the festive break. However, students should check with their respective schools for any changes to the reopening schedule.  
 6. Gujarat and Goa: Diwali Vacation Continues 
 Schools in Gujarat and Goa may continue to remain closed as part of their scheduled Diwali vacations. The reported vacation dates are November 5 to 25 in Gujarat and November 2 to 21 in Goa.  
 7. Maharashtra: School-Wise Vacation Schedule 
 Schools in Maharashtra may follow different reopening dates depending on the city and institution. Some schools in Pune and Mumbai have extended vacation schedules, so students should check their respective school notices. 
 Will Schools Remain Closed on November 17? 
 Schools in Bihar and Jharkhand will remain closed on November 17, while Delhi, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal are expected to resume regular classes. Gujarat and Goa are also observing their scheduled Diwali vacations. 
 In other states, no statewide school closure has been confirmed in the available updates. Parents and students should check the latest announcements from their schools and district administrations before heading out.
